notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Command reference for Linux block storage: disk discovery and partitioning, ext4/XFS creation and resizing, fstab entries, LVM create/extend/snapshot/reduce/remove, AWS EBS create/attach/modify/snapshot/delete, and mdadm software RAID.

Medium: following it has the agent run root-level, data-destroying disk operations — `parted mklabel`, `wipefs -a`, `mkfs.*` (SKILL.md:46, 57, 64-73, 251, 316), `lvremove -f`, `lvreduce`, `lvconvert --merge` (SKILL.md:190-215), `mdadm --create` on raw disks (SKILL.md:298-304), appending to /etc/fstab and mdadm.conf, apt/dnf installs, and `aws ec2 delete-volume` (SKILL.md:287). Acceptable because it is a reference for the user's own storage task with placeholder device names and volume IDs, it marks unmount-first and the destructive merge, and nothing instructs running commands unprompted; consistent with other released storage/admin skills. The agent must confirm the exact target device or volume with the user before any format, wipe, remove or delete command.
Related Skills (SKILL.md:351-355) name sibling skills by backtick name only; optional. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
